## Booking boundaries
Payment, booking confirmation, cancellations, refunds and date changes are handled directly with owner Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp. Ask the owner to confirm the terms for your trip in writing before you pay.
We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.
Do not interpret trip selections as confirmed bookings, guaranteed availability, or a payment. No public price list or online checkout is provided.

Contact: +919700181493; heavenlytoursandtravels1@gmail.com; https://wa.me/919700181493

## Vehicles
Sedan: An AC car for a small group. Confirm with the owner; no guaranteed seat count is published.
SUV: More space for your family and bags. Confirm with the owner; no guaranteed seat count is published.
Tempo Traveller: For families and groups travelling together. Confirm with the owner; no guaranteed seat count is published.
Mini Bus: For bigger groups. Ask us about seats. Confirm with the owner; no guaranteed seat count is published.
Bus: For large groups. Tell us how many people are coming. Confirm with the owner; no guaranteed seat count is published.

Jyotirlingas Package
https://heavenlytoursandtravels.com/trips/jyotirlingas-package
Visit the 12 Jyotirlinga shrines across India. Our team will confirm dates, travel arrangements and your preferred Vaidyanath and Nageshwar locations.
Somnath — Prabhas Patan, Gujarat
Mallikarjuna — Srisailam, Andhra Pradesh
Mahakaleshwar — Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh
Omkareshwar — Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh
Kedarnath — Uttarakhand
Bhimashankar — Maharashtra
Kashi Vishwanath — Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
Trimbakeshwar — Nashik, Maharashtra
Vaidyanath — Deoghar, Jharkhand or Parli Vaijnath, Maharashtra
Nageshwar — Dwarka, Gujarat or Aundha Nagnath, Maharashtra
Rameshwaram — Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu
Grishneshwar — Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra


Pancha Bhoota Lingas Package
https://heavenlytoursandtravels.com/trips/pancha-bhoota-lingas-package
Visit all five Pancha Bhoota temples: Earth, Water, Fire, Air and Space. We help plan the route and travel arrangements.
Earth (Prithvi) — Ekambareswarar Temple, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu; a sand lingam
Water (Jala) — Jambukeshwarar Temple, Thiruvanaikaval, Trichy, Tamil Nadu; a spring beneath the lingam
Fire (Agni) — Arunachaleswarar Temple, Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu; Shiva worshipped as fire
Air (Vayu) — Sri Kalahasteeswara Temple, Srikalahasti, Andhra Pradesh; associated with the flickering sanctum lamp
Space (Akasha) — Thillai Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu; the Chidambara Rahasya and Lord Nataraja

## Common questions
How do I book a trip?
Choose a trip and vehicle, then send your enquiry on WhatsApp. Owner Hemanth Kumar handles payment and booking confirmation directly. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking, and no payment is taken on this website.

Can I change the temples or number of days?
Yes. Use the custom trip planner or tell the owner what you need on WhatsApp. The route and date are confirmed directly with the owner.

Will you book Tirumala darshan tickets?
We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

Can older people and children travel with us?
Yes. Tell us about walking needs, rest breaks and luggage so the owner can help plan a suitable trip and vehicle.

Can you pick us up from an airport or station?
Yes. Share your arrival place and time on WhatsApp. The owner will confirm pickup arrangements.

What if I have not chosen a travel date?
You can send an enquiry now and discuss the travel date with the owner later.

How do cancellations, refunds and date changes work?
All cancellation, refund and date-change terms are handled directly with owner Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp. Ask for the terms for your trip in writing before making a payment.

Are vehicles and hotel rooms confirmed when I choose them?
No. Your selections are preferences for an enquiry. The owner confirms the vehicle, accommodation, availability and booking details directly on WhatsApp.
